propositions: Boundary and trailing whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason are hashed raw into plan-review material fingerprints and incorrectly invalidate signed attestations as stale-material.

material_basis() canonicalizes the description field but inserts no_file_impact_reason byte-for-byte without normalization when file_impact_scope equals none, causing whitespace-only variants to produce different fingerprints.

Three historical fingerprint generations must be preserved: pre-330c with raw description and raw reason, post-330c/pre-2be7 with checkbox-normalized description and raw reason, and post-2be7/pre-fix with whitespace-normalized description and raw reason.

Normalization of insignificant whitespace in no_file_impact_reason must be applied to current fingerprint calculations while legacy candidates explicitly disable reason normalization to reproduce historical byte-exact hashes.
